greeting: Chronos Future on comms. Stage 4: The Future That Waits. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Against Time. Objective drift gets teams buried.
The floor attempted a mutiny at dawn. We resolved it with better boots.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Witness the Victory vision.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Witness the Victory vision; Witness the Defeat vision; Choose your path forward. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Witness visions of possible futures. Immediate move: Witness the Victory vision.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 4 resolved: The Future That Waits. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Capital Intrigue.
rumor: Citizens keep meeting tomorrow versions of themselves and borrowing bad advice.
People keep repeating one clue from The Future That Waits: 'Choose your path forward'.
I once negotiated with a door for twenty minutes. Door won on technicalities.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn loops are usually stable. Mark your path or the street will rearrange you.
dialog.time_noon: Noon produces the most timeline echoes. Do not chase every duplicate signal.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk is paradox weather. If a clock runs backward, leave it alone.
dialog.time_night: Night splits voices from bodies. Use call-and-response to track your team.
